purpose: Primary works, homilies, letters, fragments and source status for every Church Father / patristic writer profile in Mercy.
policy: Every profile must expose the author's actual works or the status of the surviving primary corpus, not only a Mercy summary.
Local Mercy texts are preferred when a verified reusable edition has been vendored.
Historical public-domain online editions may be linked while local vendoring is pending.
Modern copyrighted translations are not copied without permission.
Lost, fragmentary, disputed or pseudonymous material is labelled as such.
A source-review status is an explicit limitation, not a substitute for a primary text.

profiles.name: St. Clement of Rome
profiles.major_works: First Letter of Clement to the Corinthians (1 Clement).
profiles.note: Complete historical public-domain translation is stored inside Mercy.

profiles.name: St. Ignatius of Antioch
profiles.major_works: Letters to the Ephesians, Magnesians, Trallians, Romans, Philadelphians, Smyrnaeans and Polycarp.
profiles.note: Seven-letter collection is available locally; later/spurious Ignatian material in the historical volume is kept distinct.

profiles.name: St. Polycarp of Smyrna
profiles.major_works: Letter to the Philippians; his death is narrated in the Martyrdom of Polycarp.

sources.label: Letter to the Philippians — local reader

profiles.note: Primary letter and early martyrdom account are available locally.
